strings.recipe_search_tip:
Words: in the item's name.
@word: needs a material with that word.
-word: leave those out.
Escape clears the search.
strings.recipe_only_tip:
Click: only favorite recipes, or all again.
Shift + click: clear every favorite.
strings.recipe_view_tip: Click: the next view. Shift + click: the one before.
strings.recipe_cat_tip: Click: only these recipes. Click others to add them, click a lit one to take it away; with none lit every recipe shows.
strings.recipe_favorite_tip: Middle click a recipe in the list does the same.
strings.recipe_favorite_off: {0} is no longer a favorite recipe
strings.recipe_none: No favorite recipes yet: middle click a recipe to add one
strings.tracker_full: The tracker holds {0} recipes at most
strings.salvage_empty: Nothing in the inventory can be salvaged.
strings.salvage_nofit: Not enough room for the salvaged materials
strings.salvage_norecipe: This item has no recipe to salvage
strings.salvage_excluded: This item is excluded from salvaging
strings.salvage_moddata: Another mod keeps data on this item; it is not salvaged
strings.salvage_equipped: Unequip the item before salvaging it
strings.salvage_unknown: You do not know this recipe yet
strings.salvage_nostation: The recipe's crafting station is not in range
strings.salvage_chest_wait: Taking the item from the chest...
strings.salvage_chest_changed: The item in the chest changed; nothing was salvaged
strings.salvage_chest_busy: The chest cannot be used right now; nothing was salvaged
strings.salvage_dropped: Some materials did not fit and were dropped at your feet
strings.sort_tip: Click: next sort. Shift + click: previous sort.
strings.step_aside: Kindle is off while {0} is installed.
strings.needs_burrow: Needs Burrow; carried materials are still counted.
strings.cartcraft: Shift + Use: craft at the cart workbench
strings.virtualnone: Your last crafting station is not loaded. Use a station first, then stay within its loaded area.
strings.virtualoff: Virtual Workbench is off on this server.
strings.import_available: Reference settings found. Preview is available in the Kindle config.
strings.repair_all_tip_none: Nothing here needs repair at this station.
strings.salvage_station_tip: Opens Salvage with the selected item.
strings.salvage_station_none: Nothing you carry can be salvaged here.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__search_help: Show a search row above the recipe list on the Craft and Upgrade tabs.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__search_key_help: Focuses the search field (or opens Steam's on-screen keyboard). Empty: no key.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__clear_search_on_close_h: Clear the search text when the inventory closes.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__ignore_accents_help: Search ignores accent marks, so plain letters also find accented names.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__categories_help: A row of category buttons under the search: Ammo, Weapons, Bows, Armor, Shields, Tools, Food and Materials. Click one to list only its recipes, click more to add them, click a lit one to take it away; with none lit every recipe shows.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__favorites_help: Allow marking recipes as favorites (middle click, the favorite key or the star button).
strings.cfg_recipe_list__favorites_first_help: List favorite recipes before the others, keeping the chosen sort within each group.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__favorite_recipe_key_hel: Marks or unmarks the recipe under the pointer. Acts only over a recipe row. Unbound by default; middle click and the star button also mark favorites.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__recipe_view_help: How recipes are laid out: List, CompactList, SmallGrid, MediumGrid or LargeGrid.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__sort_button_help: Show the sort button. Off hides the button; the stored sort (the game's sortcraft) still applies.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__gamepad_controls_help: Lets a gamepad move through and use the search, sort and favorite controls of the recipe list.
strings.cfg_recipe_list__gamepad_sort_button_hel: Gamepad button that cycles the sort while the crafting panel is selected (a Crucible pad button name). Default Back, which the game leaves free in the inventory; holding the left stick stays the game's multi-craft modifier. Empty: off.
strings.cfg_batch_crafting__enabled_help: Show the amount stepper left of Craft; Craft makes that many through the game's own multi-craft, at the same cost per item.
strings.cfg_batch_crafting__max_amount_help: The most one press of Craft makes. Materials and free inventory space still limit the amount.
strings.cfg_batch_crafting__craft_speed_help: Cheat. How fast crafting completes: 2 takes half the game's time. Reads 1 whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_batch_crafting__instant_crafting_hel: Cheat. Every craft and batch finishes at once, ignoring Craft Speed. Off whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_repair__repair_on_station_open_help: Opening a usable crafting station repairs all carried worn items that station can repair, using the same free repair-all action. Off by default.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__enabled_help: Show tracked recipes and their materials on the HUD.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__max_tracked_help: The most recipes tracked at once.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__count_nearby_chests_: Count materials in nearby containers. Needs Burrow; without it only carried items count.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__untrack_when_crafted: Stop tracking a recipe once the tracked amount has been crafted.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__hide_in_combat_help: Hide the tracker while in combat.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__hide_with_map_help: Hide the tracker while the large map is open.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__font_help: Tracker font: Sans, Serif or Norse.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__font_size_help: Text size of the recipe tracker on the HUD.
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__have_color_help: Color of materials you have enough of (HTML color, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA).
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__missing_color_help: Color of materials you are missing (HTML color).
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__ready_color_help: Color of a recipe title once everything is gathered (HTML color).
strings.cfg_recipe_tracker__background_opacity_h: Opacity of the tracker panel background.
strings.cfg_salvage__enabled_help: Add a Salvage tab to crafting stations that turns unwanted gear back into materials.
strings.cfg_salvage__return_fraction_help: Share of each material's total cost returned by salvage.
strings.cfg_salvage__rounding_help: How a share becomes a whole number: Floor, Round (halves up) or Ceil.
strings.cfg_salvage__at_least_one_help: Every material returns at least one.
strings.cfg_salvage__upgrade_materials_help: Include the materials spent on upgrades.
strings.cfg_salvage__require_known_recipe_help: Only salvage items whose recipe the character knows. Found gear (loot, chest, trader or creature drops, which no one crafted) always counts as known, as does every recipe when the world unlocks all recipes.
strings.cfg_salvage__require_station_help: Only salvage at the item's own crafting station.
strings.cfg_salvage__skip_items_with_mod_data_he: Never salvage items carrying data from other mods (keys starting with Mod Data Prefixes).
strings.cfg_salvage__mod_data_prefixes_help: Comma list of item data key prefixes (case-sensitive) that mark an item as carrying other mods' data.
strings.cfg_salvage__salvage_key_help: Salvages the item under the pointer on the Salvage tab. Unbound by default; the Salvage button does the same.
strings.cfg_salvage__show_rarity_backgrounds_hel: Show rarity backgrounds on the Salvage tab (also obeys Epic Loot's own setting).
strings.cfg_salvage__nearby_chests_help: The Salvage tab also lists gear in the nearby chests Burrow lets you craft from (needs Burrow: its range, wards and chest rules apply, and chests other players have open are skipped). Salvaged materials go to your inventory; what does not fit drops at your feet. Your own value applies in single player; on a server the host's value applies.
strings.cfg_cart_workbench__cart_workbench_help: Cheat. Every loaded cart carries a workbench; Shift + Use opens it. Off whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_cart_workbench__cart_station_level_h: Workbench level of a cart before extensions.
strings.cfg_cart_workbench__cart_station_range_h: Range of a cart's workbench in meters.
strings.cfg_virtual_workbench__virtual_workbench: Host setting, off by default. Lets players reopen the crafting station they used last from anywhere it is still loaded, with Virtual Workbench Key. That station's own level, extensions, roof and fire rules apply, and crafting uses only carried materials, as at the station.
Your own key that reopens the crafting station you used last, when the host allows Virtual Workbench. Empty: no key.
strings.cfg_crafting_stations__use_distance_mult: How far you can stand from a crafting station and still use it, as a multiple of the game's distance for that station (1 is the game's). Your own value applies in single player; on a server the host's value applies.
strings.cfg_server__locked_player_settings_help: Retained compatibility key. Server lock lists no longer override client-local settings.
strings.cfg_import__preview_openkeep_help: Write a preview report without changing any source or target settings. Resets after running.
strings.cfg_import__apply_openkeep_help: Apply the previewed reference settings with a target backup. Source files remain intact. Resets after running.
strings.cfg_import__binding_overrides_help: Replacement shortcuts as Section.Key=value, separated by semicolons, for collisions shown by Preview.
